sentences.text: Shri Sudama Shakya - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Anurag Sharma - Public Prosecutor for respondent/
 Shri Shubhendu Singh Chauhan - Advocate for the compla  ORDER I.A. No.12557/2024 , an application u/S. 301 (2) of Cr.P.C. is taken up, considered and allowed for the reasons mentioned therein.
Mr. S.S.Chauhan - Advocate and his associates are permitted to assist the State counsel in the prosecution of this application.

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.347 of 2024 registered at Police Station Maharajpura, District Gwalior (M.P.)
for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 (2) (N) of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent person and has been falsely implicated.
It is further argued that allegedly, the prosecutrix got missing on 04.05.2024 and was recovered on 05.05.2024.

Thereafter, in her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.,she NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:15577 2 MCRC-26151-2024 specifically stated that she called the applicant/accused on mobile to take her with him, however, when he refused, she herself left her house on her own volition with ornament and cash.
Since the prosecutrix has been examined, therefore, question of abduction does not arise.

Further submission is that the ornament Arman Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134003509/
1 and cash have already been recovered.

sentences.text: After completion of investigation, charge sheet has already been filed, therefore, his custodial interrogation is not required anymore.
The applicant is under custody since 05.05.2024 and he is not having criminal antecedent of same nature.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Gwalior.
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no possibility of his absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor for respondent/the State as well as the counsel for the complainant opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
